decisions.decision_value: Initial selling price of 25 Euros and unit production cost limit of 12.50 Euros
decisions.rationale: Initial upper management specification for a TV-only remote control with a 25 Euro selling price and 12.50 Euro production budget
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Twenty-five Euros is the selling price, we really have to innovate here I guess.

decisions.decision_value: Proposal by Speaker D (Marketing Expert) to abandon the 25 Euro mid-market price and market the remote as a high-priced, exclusive product at 50-60 Euros wholesale (or up to 89 Euros)
decisions.rationale: Speaker D argued that 25 Euros is a mid-market price where multi-function remotes compete at 18-19 Euros on sale, so a TV-only remote needs high-end exclusive positioning ('the Rolls Royce of remote controls') with a higher price tag
decisions.semantic_target_quote: I'm an advocate to make this an exclusive product. You know, let's let's sell this wholesale for for fifty Euros, sixty Euros.

decisions.decision_value: Retain teletext functionality despite management suggestion that teletext is becoming outdated
decisions.rationale: 80-95% of TVs still use teletext and including it only requires a button with negligible extra cost
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Nah, I think we can say with certainty now that we are supporting teletext.

decisions.decision_value: Investigate a rechargeable power cradle with a permanent internal power cell and paging/locator button instead of replaceable batteries
decisions.rationale: Environmentally friendly ('never buy another battery'), prevents losing the remote, and provides strong marketing differentiation
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Well maybe not a solar remote but instead what about if we had like a power cradle?

decisions.decision_value: Rechargeable power cradle/dock with radio transmitter locator/paging beep feature and regular chip
decisions.rationale: Provides strong eco-friendly and anti-loss differentiation that justifies a higher, more exclusive price bracket
decisions.semantic_target_quote: my personal preference is focusing the p the product on the idea of the uh the case the the uh dock to put it in

decisions.decision_value: Plastic inner shell with durable rubber outer shell, rubber push-buttons, back-lit buttons/mode indicator, and a programmable scroll wheel for channel surfing and favourite channels (no LCD display, no speech recognition)
decisions.rationale: Scroll wheel with programmable favourite channels ('zapping') adds unique surfing appeal while rubber-over-plastic casing ensures durability
decisions.semantic_target_quote: Okay so we'll come up with something between thirty five and fifty that is rug rubber, robust, with scroll wheel,

decisions.decision_value: Higher selling price range of 35 to 50 Euros (approved by upper management after Speaker D pushed for higher, exclusive pricing)
decisions.rationale: Upper management approved raising the price from the initial 25 Euros; Speaker B suggested 35-40 Euros and Speaker D proposed 35-50 Euros, which Speaker A confirmed as the sales bracket
decisions.semantic_target_quote: 'Kay. Thirty five to fifty Euros is our sales bracket okay. So the question is what we ca we make it for.

decisions.decision_value: Confirmed 35 to 50 Euro selling price range positioned for exclusivity, with a final unit production cost of 15.80 Euros (within the revised 20 Euro production budget)
decisions.rationale: Speaker D reaffirmed marketing the remote at 35 to 50 Euros for exclusivity rather than lowering the price to 25 Euros, and the final component cost was verified at 15.80 Euros per unit
decisions.semantic_target_quote: to make it marketable I believe at a cost of of of thirty thirty five to to fifty Euros.
